description: Layout, shared components, and all six pages. This is the UI layer built on top of the FEAT-001 data/logic layer.
steps: Step 1 — App shell: Update src/App.tsx to use React Router v6 BrowserRouter with routes: / → Overview, /purchase-orders → PurchaseOrders, /suppliers → Suppliers, /suppliers/:id → SupplierProfile, /issue-analysis → IssueAnalysis, /recommendations → Recommendations. Wrap all routes inside a Layout component with Outlet.
Step 2 — Layout: Create src/components/layout/Layout.tsx (Outlet + Sidebar + Header), src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx (navigation links), src/components/layout/Header.tsx (page title).
Step 3 — Shared components: KPICard, StatusBadge, HiddenIssueCard, RiskBadge, Tooltip wrapper.

Step 4 — Overview page: src/pages/Overview.tsx — KPI cards for total suppliers, total POs, avg reliability score, hidden issues count. Bar chart of supplier reliability scores. Risk distribution pie chart.
Step 5 — Purchase Orders page: src/pages/PurchaseOrders.tsx — filterable table of all POs with supplier, product, dates, status, risk indicators.
Step 6 — Suppliers page: src/pages/Suppliers.tsx — supplier cards/table with metrics and risk badges, link to profile.
Step 7 — Supplier Profile page: src/pages/SupplierProfile.tsx — detailed view with product-level metrics, hidden issues, recommendations for that supplier.
Step 8 — Issue Analysis page: src/pages/IssueAnalysis.tsx — most delayed suppliers, recurring delay products, quantity shortfall, quality problems, heatmap.
Step 9 — Recommendations page: src/pages/Recommendations.tsx — full recommendations list with filters by priority and supplier.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors

SUP001 profile shows Medium overall risk but flags PRD001 as a hidden critical delivery issue
Issue Analysis shows GlobalTech Solutions as top delayed supplier for PRD001
Recommendations page shows at least one High priority recommendation for SUP001
